text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: …It's as I suspected. My technique has lost its edge. The additional weight may have increased my raw power, but by the same token, my speed has suffered.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: This is a grave situation. I must return to my former weight as soon as possible.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hi there, Yaeno. I see that you're training as hard as I am!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Say, do you happen to have some free time later? I baked some rice crackers, so I was thinking we could enjoy them together.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I even made some special spicy ones for you! Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: What consideration! Thank you. I'm looking forward to sampling them.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Okay then, I'll drop by later!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: …I'll not be the one to put a frown on that face.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I cannot refuse Chiyono O's kind offer. I'll just have to work off any calories contained within those rice crackers!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With unwavering determination, Yaeno Muteki successfully achieves her target weight.
